note: told-when-asked (item 128): when the owner types "tell me when X" (or "let me know when", "ping me when"), the manager's later reply titled ANSWER about X passes the no-news and manager-says checks once, on any turn, whoever started it. A request with no key word, an ANSWER about something else, an untitled reply and a second reply for the same request stay refused. Both copies; listed on docs/checks.md.
